execution_traces.path_summary: Called with LS-COMMAND-AREA. Opens PORTFOLIO-FILE (I-O), then performs create (C), read (R), update (U) or delete (D) of one portfolio record keyed by PORT-ID; any other command is an error. Every error path goes through 9000-ERROR, which sets return code 8, closes the file and GOBACKs immediately. On success the file is closed, WS-RETURN-CODE is returned in LS-RETURN-CODE and the program GOBACKs. A successful update also calls AUDPROC through 2100-LOG-PORTFOLIO-UPDATE.

program_narrative: PORTMSTR is a batch subprogram that maintains the indexed Portfolio master file (PORTFILE, key PORT-ID). The caller passes a one-character command and a 100-byte portfolio record. The program opens the file for update and then creates (C), reads (R), updates (U) or deletes (D) the record. Create and update first validate the record: the ID must start with 'PORT' followed by five digits, the name must not be blank and the status must be A, I or C. Create rejects duplicate IDs; read returns the record to the caller; update and delete report records that do not exist; a successful update is audited by calling AUDPROC. Any failure (open error, validation error, I/O status other than success, unknown command) sets return code 8, closes the file and returns to the caller immediately; otherwise the file is closed and return code 0 is passed back in LS-RETURN-CODE. The paragraph 2100-HANDLE-VSAM-ERROR is unreachable, and it and 2100-LOG-PORTFOLIO-UPDATE use data names that are not declared in the program.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
pseudocode: -- Main control: initialise, run the requested maintenance command, terminate
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
CALL 1000-initialize
IF command = 'C' THEN
  CALL 2000-create-portfolio
ELSE IF command = 'R' THEN
  CALL 3000-read-portfolio
ELSE IF command = 'U' THEN
  CALL 4000-update-portfolio
ELSE IF command = 'D' THEN
  CALL 5000-delete-portfolio
ELSE
  SET error_text = 'Invalid command'
  CALL 9000-error
END IF
CALL 6000-terminate
RETURN to caller

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
pseudocode: CLEAR work_areas  -- INITIALIZE WS-WORK-AREAS: current date to spaces, return code to zero
OPEN PORTFOLIO-FILE for READ-WRITE  -- indexed file PORTFILE, dynamic access, key PORT-ID
SET current_date = system date (YYYYMMDD)  -- ACCEPT ... FROM DATE YYYYMMDD
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:

OPEN PORTFOLIO-FILE for READ-WRITE
IF portfolio_file_status != '00' THEN

END IF

paragraphs.name: 2000-CREATE-PORTFOLIO
pseudocode: SET portfolio_record = caller_portfolio  -- MOVE LS-PORTFOLIO (100 bytes) TO PORTFOLIO-RECORD
IF portfolio_file_status = '22' THEN  -- PORT-DUP-KEY: duplicate key
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:

CALL 2100-validate-portfolio
IF return_code != success THEN
